new_defects.title: Result block 'Already judged here, kept' over-counts: per-item snapshots are summed across a multi-backup run
new_defects.repro:
1. On tgtB, after importing the 4 distinct backups (a corpus with about 6 446 sources), open Settings → Data & backup → Import.
2. Scan /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I/backups_cum (4 cumulative backups).
3. Import only the corpus, with the dialog kept open until the result block renders.
4. Look at the source-qualification part of the result block.
new_defects.expected: 'Already judged here, kept' counts each source at most once. It can never exceed the number of sources in the corpus.
new_defects.actual: 'Already judged here, kept: 19 254' (ar «سبق الحكم عليها هنا، أُبقيت: 19 254», zh «此处已判定并保留：19 254»). That is about three times the corpus's 6 446 sources. The per-item plans' _source_qualification.local_verdict_kept values are 6400, 6422, 6418 and 14, and the UI adds them up.
new_defects.evidence: shots/B_ar-end.png and the D_zh result-block shot; B_*_samples.jsonl and D_zh_samples.jsonl; the per-item plan values come from /api/backup/import-queue/status.
new_defects.root_cause_lead: src/static/app-backup.js ~2622-2632 does `qualKept += pq.local_verdict_kept || 0` over every item's plan, but each item's value is a snapshot of the whole local set, not a per-item increment. qualEngines and qualDisagreed are summed the same way. It should take the last item's snapshot or a de-duplicated union. This is the same class as the earlier D6 summing defect.

items.ref: new:Result block 'Already judged here, kept' over-counts: per-item snapshots are summed across a multi-backup run
items.evidence:
My own instance: /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I-recheck/tgt1 on port 8953. Created through the real first launch (en, legal, the data-location step, passphrase walk-pass-2026). It booted with lock-state 'locked' and was unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock. I imported copies of the walker's backup sets (copied into /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I-recheck/backups and /backups_cum): first the 4 distinct backups in fr, then the 4 cumulative backups in zh with the dialog open.

Source counts, paged through /api/sources/: 6 416 before the cumulative import and 6 446 after it.

The zh result block reads '此处已判定并保留：19 254'. See events.jsonl R_zh_result_block and shots/zh-result-block.png.

The persisted per-item reports rep-5..8.json (plan._source_qualification.local_verdict_kept) give 6400, 6422, 6418 and 14. Their sum is exactly 19 254, three times the corpus's 6 446 sources.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-backup.js:2627 does `qualKept += pq.local_verdict_kept || 0` for every counted item, and :2771 renders the sum as 'Already judged here, kept'. Each item's figure (src/backup/merge.py:2188, `local_verdict_kept`) counts every incoming source that already had a local verdict. A source carried by N backups of the same run is therefore counted N times. The other qualification counters (introduced/adopted) are disjoint across items and sum correctly; this one does not.
items.suggested_fix: Give the aggregate a distinct count. Either the queue computes a run-level tally of the distinct local source ids whose verdict was kept (union across the run's items), or the aggregate drops this line for multi-item runs and leaves the figure in each backup's own detail. Do not sum per-item snapshots. The first walk's I6 (a re-index backlog summed per item) had the same shape and was rated P2, hence P2 here.

items.ref: new:Raw backend sentinel 'unrecorded' shown as an engine name in 'Judged by'
items.evidence: zh result block, same run as the item above: '判定引擎：unrecorded (1), v1 (25)' (events.jsonl R_zh_result_block, shots/zh-result-block.png). The per-item report rep-5.json has engines {"unrecorded": 1, "v1": 21}; the 1 is the one source that arrived disqualified with no criteria version recorded. The UI prints the backend key verbatim. It is English inside a zh sentence and the same token in every locale.
items.root_cause: src/backup/merge.py:2166-2170 deliberately reports a verdict with no recorded criteria version under the literal key 'unrecorded' (docstring :2152-2155). src/static/app-backup.js:2773-2777 then joins `${e} (${num(n)})` for every engine key without mapping that sentinel to a translated phrase.
items.suggested_fix: In the Judged-by join, map the key 'unrecorded' to t('engine not recorded'), keyed x12, and leave real criteria versions (v1 ...) as data. Alternatively the backend can send the sentinel as null/None with a separate count, and the UI words it.

items.evidence: Measured on the label's line box nearest the dot, DSF 2, same build. In LTR (en), every stage row and per-backup row has a 6 px gap between dot and label (dot right edge 467, label left edge 473). In RTL (ar), every row has a 0 px gap (dot left edge 967 = label right edge 967). The dot's computed margin-right is 6px and its margin-left 0px in both directions. See events.jsonl I4_en_gap / I4_ar_gap, and shots/i4-ar-stages-dsf2.png and i4-ar-rows-dsf2.png beside i4-en-*-dsf2.png. In ar, the '1.' and the backup folder names sit flush against the dot.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-backup.js:1874 (per-backup rows) and :1935 (stage rows) build the dot with the physical `margin-right:6px`. In RTL the dot is drawn on the right, so the margin lands on its outer side and nothing separates it from the label.
items.suggested_fix: Replace margin-right:6px with margin-inline-end:6px on both dot spans. Check other inline dots in the dialog the same way.

items.ref: new:Reopening Import after a scan keeps the previous scan's trust row, its caveat and the folder path
items.evidence: en. I scanned /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I-recheck/backups, closed the dialog without running, and reopened it. Measured 1.5 s and 5.5 s after the reopen: trust row display 'block' with its caveat, #ux-imp-src still holding the path, checklist '', status '', pass-row 'none', Run disabled (events.jsonl I5_reopen_1_5s / I5_reopen_5_5s, shots/i5-reopen-dialog-en.png). A trust checkbox and its caveat stand under an empty checklist. It is worse after a FINISHED import: reopening after the fr and zh runs also showed the trust row as 'block' (I5b_reopen_after_import, R_zh_reopen_row4.st). S04-02 S2's acceptance for a reopen is 'the line, nothing else'.
items.root_cause: src/static/app-backup.js:923-946 (openUnifiedImport) resets the checklist, status, progress, summary, last line, bar, pass-row and Run, and calls _uxImResetRunView (:2199), but never hides #ux-imp-trust-row. That row's display is set only by _uxImTrustRow (:1196-1199), which only a scan calls. #ux-imp-src is not cleared either.
items.suggested_fix: In openUnifiedImport, call the trust-row hide as well (row.style.display='none', or _uxImTrustRow(false)). Then decide deliberately whether the folder path should persist. Keeping it as a convenience is defensible, but then the form should not look half-scanned.

items.ref: new:Task manager re-index detail 'import N (M article(s))' is English with an ungrouped number in fr and zh
items.evidence: fr: during the stage-4 drain I followed the stage-4 link to /tasks. The job shows 'fin de la réindexation des articles importés' (translated), then 'import 2 (1200 article(s))' (English, 1200 ungrouped), then '1 700 / 4 800 éléments · 35%' (grouped). See shots/i6-fr-taskmanager.png and events I6_fr_tasks. zh: 'import 5 (773 article(s))' (shots/i6-zh-taskmanager.png, I6_zh_tasks). /api/jobs returns detail 'import 2 (1200 article(s))' with detail_i18n null.
items.root_cause: src/api/backup_v2.py:1008 `ctx.set_progress(detail=f"import {bid} ({b['articles']} article(s))")` passes a plain str, not a src/jobs/background.py:40 `Framed`, so detail_i18n/detail_vars stay null. src/static/taskmanager.html:383-385 (jobDetail) then falls back to t(j.detail); no key matches, so the English sentence prints with its raw number.
items.suggested_fix: Publish the line as a Framed detail with a keyed frame and values: the batch id, plus the article count as a one/many count phrase formatted by fmtNum. This is the pattern the 'model {model}' and qualify_job producers use. Add the frame keys to all 12 locales.

items.ref: new:Stage 4's dot stays grey ('not started' colour) while the re-index is running
items.evidence: fr, dialog kept open after the run. For 12 s, row 4 read 'reprise de la réindexation — 200 … 1 000 articles sur 4 800' while /reindex-backlog/resume/status was 'running'. The dot was var(--muted) = rgb(92,101,115) at every sample (events I7_fr_open_seq, shots/i7-fr-open-stages-crop.png). It was the same on reopens mid-drain (I7_fr_reopen, I7_fr_drain_reopen at 2 100 and 3 600 of 4 800) and in zh (R_zh_reopen_row4). Once finished, row 4 reads 'complete' and the dot is still var(--muted) (I4_ar_gap/I4_en_gap reindex bg var(--muted)), so neither the running colour nor the done colour ever appears.
items.root_cause: src/backup/import_queue.py:1307 always reports the reindex stage as state 'external', by design, because the queue does not own that job. src/static/app-backup.js:1892-1895 colours every stage row's dot from sRow.state alone, so 'external' maps to var(--muted) while the row's TEXT comes from rx (_uxImReindexBits). Text and dot are fed by different sources.
items.suggested_fix: For key==='reindex', derive the dot from rx, the same status the text uses: running gives var(--accent); a zero backlog with nothing left gives var(--ok); idle with a backlog gives var(--warn); unread stays var(--muted).

items.ref: new:zh result-block wording: half-width punctuation and 您 beside 你 in the same dialog
items.evidence: zh result block (events R_zh_result_block / R_zh_dialog_text_end, shots/zh-result-block.png). It shows '您的语料库新增了 933 篇文章,来自 30 个新来源,涵盖 4 种新语言。' (half-width commas) and '数据库记录(所有类型)：11 185' (half-width parentheses). The same dialog text uses 你 six times: the intro '你已有的内容不会被覆盖', the checklist, stage 2 '合并进你的语料库并保存', the statement '…现已进入你的语料库', and the checkpoint caveat. The result block uses 您 twice: the growth sentence and '您的语料库是如何增长的'. The locale file mixes both forms app-wide (176 lines with 您, 239 with 你), but within this dialog the mix shows side by side. Minor, related: the checklist wrapper prints half-width parentheses around '(加密卷 — …)' from JS.
items.root_cause: src/static/locales/zh.json:2365 'database records, all types' => '数据库记录(所有类型)'. zh.json:2366 'Your corpus grew by …' uses ',' where '，' is wanted, plus 您. zh.json:2348 'How your corpus grew' => '您的语料库是如何增长的'.
items.suggested_fix: Use full-width punctuation in zh.json:2365-2366 ('数据库记录（所有类型）', '，'), and switch 您 to 你 in 2348 and 2366 to match the rest of the Import dialog. A zh-wide 您/你 pass is a separate, larger decision.

recheck.summary:
I reproduced all 8 of the walker's items for row I on build 0deff9c4, on my own fresh instance, and all 8 are confirmed. None came from the walker's scripts, and none is ruled behaviour.

**Setup.** The instance is /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I-recheck/tgt1 on port 8953, created through the real first launch. It is encrypted, booted with lock-state 'locked', and was unlocked through #pw/#btn-unlock. I imported copies of the walker's backup sets, placed in my scratch folder: first the 4 distinct stamp-stripped backups in fr, then the 4 cumulative backups in zh. I then re-imported the cumulative set in ar and en for the RTL measurements. Chromium ran headless with the no-network args, and the app stayed in airplane mode throughout; no consent popup arose. There were no page errors, console errors, HTTP errors of 400 or above, or undefined/NaN/null text on this path.

**Confirmed items:**
1. **P2, 'Already judged here, kept' over-counts.** The zh result block shows 19 254, while the corpus has 6 446 sources. It is the sum of the four per-item values 6400, 6422, 6418 and 14 (app-backup.js:2627).
2. **P3, raw 'unrecorded' in 'Judged by'.** The backend sentinel from merge.py:2166 is printed verbatim by app-backup.js:2773-2777.
3. **P3, #ux-imp-src has no dir='ltr' (index.html:3271).** In ar, /mnt/backup renders as 'mnt/backup/' and long paths are clipped at the start; #ux-dest renders the same path correctly.
4. **P3, RTL dot gap is 0 px against 6 px in LTR.** Caused by the physical margin-right at app-backup.js:1874 and :1935.
5. **P3, trust row and folder survive a reopen.** openUnifiedImport (app-backup.js:923-946) never hides #ux-imp-trust-row. It also survives a reopen after a finished import, which breaks S04-02 S2's 'the line, nothing else'.
6. **P3, task-manager detail is not translated.** fr shows 'import 2 (1200 article(s))' and zh 'import 5 (773 article(s))', because backup_v2.py:1008 publishes a plain string rather than a Framed detail.
7. **P3, stage 4's dot stays grey.** It stays var(--muted) while the re-index runs and after it completes, because import_queue.py:1307 always reports 'external' and app-backup.js:1892 colours the dot from that alone.
8. **P3, zh wording.** Half-width ',' and '()' plus 您 at zh.json:2348, 2365 and 2366, while the rest of the dialog says 你.

**Artifacts** are in /tmp/claude-0/rewalk/I-recheck/: walk1-4.py, rc.py, rcrun.py, gap.py, srv.py, events.jsonl, rep-5..8.json, errors_walk*.json and 55 screenshots in shots/. My server (PID 17887) was stopped by PID, port 8953 is free, and the worktree is clean.
